items.name: Charter extension for six 15,400 TEU container vessels with Hapag-Lloyd
items.claim: SFL agreed a charter extension for six 15,400 TEU container vessels with Hapag-Lloyd AG for an additional seven years, adding approximately $750 million to backlog.
items.source_excerpt: SFL - Charter Extension for 6 x 15,400 TEU vessels adding $750 Million Backlog SFL Corporation Ltd. (NYSE: SFL) (the “Company”) announced today that it has agreed a charter extension for six 15,400 TEU container vessels with Hapag-Lloyd AG for additional seven years.

items.name: Fixed-rate charter backlog after the Hapag-Lloyd extension
items.claim: The new time charter contracts add approximately $750 million to SFL's fixed rate charter backlog, increasing the backlog to approximately $4.6 billion.
items.source_excerpt: The new time charter contracts will add approximately $750 million to SFL’s fixed rate charter backlog, increasing the backlog 1 to approximately $4.6 billion.

notes: Both items sourced from the stored September 11, 2026 6-K exhibit (data/edgar/docs/SFL.json). Footnote 1 in the source ("backlog 1 to approximately $4.6 billion") defines the backlog as fixed rate backlog as of June 30, 2026 including fully owned vessels and rigs and 100% of four partially owned 19,000 TEU container vessels, plus subsequent transactions.
